goal: Play a full round and use the new feature: Create executable checks (forge checks --plan) that run a live playtest and assert the telemetry counters: map_built=1, plaza_built=1, themes_built=6, plot_assigned (after claim or the 20s auto-claim), auto_claims, cubes_dropped rising about every 2s, cubes_collected rising, cashin_fx_sent>0, and Cash rising. Also assert that there are no output errors or warnings and that cubes_dropped stays 0 before a claim. Run them, then hand any failing check to the fixer. Keep existing counter names unchanged.
summary: The playtester waited, bought Dropper 2 and Silver Ore, and watched the counters. cubes_dropped rose by 2 about every 2.2s, cubes_collected and cashin_fx_sent rose with it, Cash grew, and map_built=1, plaza_built=1 and plot_assigned=1 were as expected. The themes_built=6 check fails because the counter is 12. The run also never tested that cubes_dropped stays 0 before a claim, and it never ran or handed off the forge checks, so the goal was not met.

bugs.title: themes_built is 12, expected 6
bugs.evidence: Probe counters show themes_built=12 while map_built=1 and plaza_built=1. The themes appear to be built twice. The planned check themes_built=6 would fail.

bugs.title: plots_claimed and auto_claims are 2 with only one player and plot_assigned=1
bugs.evidence: Probe counters show plots_claimed=2 and auto_claims=2, but plot_assigned=1 and only one player (retailtycoonlover21) is present. The claim or auto-claim logic seems to run twice, possibly the same double-run as themes_built=12.

bugs.title: checks_failed counter already 1 with no failing check identified
bugs.evidence: Probe counters show checks_failed=1 even though the probe's errors list is empty. The trace never shows which check failed, so the failure cannot be traced or handed to the fixer. The themes_built mismatch is a likely cause.

bugs.title: physics_drift=1 warning-type counter is non-zero
bugs.evidence: Probe counters show physics_drift=1. The goal requires no output errors or warnings, and the counter is not explained anywhere in the trace.

bugs.title: No evidence that cubes_dropped stays 0 before a claim
bugs.evidence: At step 1, after a 10s wait, the HUD already showed Cash and a claimed plot (plot_assigned=1). The pre-claim window was never observed, so the 'cubes_dropped = 0 before claim' assertion cannot be verified. The auto-claim may also fire early.
